subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2a688b37df359a1cba9a39c459a9658c7a5128b820519ad1c2abfac5935a33a.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) The whole element shift 45º clockwise.

2) The two element interchange positions.

3) The left element is flipped vertically.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22e4da6d734d04e6fd0ed2f9f6b3f5f33ad52be59bf19ea7ecb2facceec0e0b1.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ff6a1f19007f191c4cfc1c4c21a200cdc1d87dd762229e0c48905fce0aca06a.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
